blinds.line: Then you'd turn and close the blinds
stanza: I used to call you on the telephone
I couldn't catch my breath
To expel a single word
You would hang up your telephone
You always looked confused
Then you'd turn and close the blinds
Then came the glow
Of a single candle
Through the blinds
In the rising sun
In the rising sun

blinds.line: Big sun coming strong through the motel blinds
stanza: Big sun coming strong through the motel blinds
Wake up to your girl
For now, let's call her Cleopatra, Cleopatra
I'll watch you fix your hair
Then put your panties on in the mirror, Cleopatra
Then your lipstick, Cleopatra
Then your six-inch heels, catch her
She's headed to the pyramid

blinds.line: Open eyes, street lights float slowly through broken blinds
blinds.lineNext: She watches as the light plays across the tattered carpet

minds.line: We thought that we could change their minds
stanza: Doesn't seem so long ago
We thought that we could change their minds
We'd stay here and fight it out
With a love that we could weaponize
But I saw you losing faith
And I was watching when the light went out
You know what revolution means
And you know it's not an option now
When shadows take your hand
And mist is on the land
Hold on to your minds

minds.line: I've been for real, baby, with the troubled minds
stanza: I come up hard, baby
I've been for real, baby, with the troubled minds
I'm moving, going to town
I come up hard, I come up gettin' down
There's only three things for sure
Taxes, death, and trouble, oh
This I've known, baby, this I've known, baby
Ain't gonna let it sweat me, babe
Woo, oh lord, baby

minds.line: Trying to make other people lose their minds
stanza: People walk around everyday
Playing games and taking scores
Trying to make other people lose their minds
Well, be careful you don't lose yours
